document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Ask a group of teenagers about the latest song by a Korean pop band and most will answer at once; ask them about the events that shaped their own nation and many will hesitate. This essay will argue that this imbalance is caused mainly by the way media and schools compete for young people’s attention, and that it is a largely negative development, though not an irreversible one.

The main reason is the sheer volume of entertainment that young people consume. Social media platforms and streaming services are designed to keep users watching, and their algorithms constantly promote famous performers, influencers and athletes. National history, by contrast, is often met only in school textbooks, where it may be presented as a list of dates and names to memorise for an exam. It is hardly surprising, therefore, that celebrities seem more interesting and relevant.
To some extent, this trend is harmless. Following international stars can improve young people’s English and give them shared interests with peers around the world.

Nevertheless, the overall effect is negative. A society whose citizens do not understand their past finds it harder to make sense of its present. In Kazakhstan, for instance, knowing the history of the Kazakh Khanate or of the difficult twentieth century helps young people appreciate their national identity. Without such knowledge, they are also more vulnerable to distorted versions of history spread online.

In conclusion, young people know celebrities better than their history because entertainment is more accessible than the way history is taught. This is a negative development, but schools and museums could reverse it by presenting the past through stories, films and the digital media that young people already use.

note.en: Introduces a thesis answering both questions.
note.kk: Екі сұраққа жауабы бар тезисті енгізеді.
note.ru: Вводит тезис с ответом на оба вопроса.

note.en: Softens the judgement: negative, but reversible.
note.kk: Бағаны жұмсартады: жаман, бірақ түзетуге болады.

note.en: The topic sentence of the causes paragraph.

note.kk: Ойын-сауық пен мектептегі тарихты қарама-қарсы қояды.

note.en: A conclusion drawn from the two facts in the paragraph.
Returns to the main judgement — negative.
Introduces an example from Kazakh history.

strengths.en: The contrast between two questions shows the problem at once, without clichés.
strengths.kk: Екі сұрақтың қарама-қайшылығы мәселені жалпы сөзсіз бірден көрсетеді.
strengths.ru: Контраст двух вопросов сразу показывает проблему без общих фраз.
strengths.example: Ask a group of teenagers about the latest song by a Korean pop band

strengths.en: The writer blames not only social media but also the way history is taught.
strengths.kk: Автор әлеуметтік желілерді ғана емес, тарихтың қалай оқытылатынын да сынайды.
strengths.ru: Автор винит не только соцсети, но и то, как преподают историю.
strengths.example: presented as a list of dates and names to memorise for an exam

strengths.en: The Kazakh Khanate and the twentieth century make an abstract “history” concrete.
strengths.kk: Қазақ хандығы мен XX ғасыр абстрактілі «тарихты» нақты етеді.
strengths.ru: Казахское ханство и XX век делают абстрактную «историю» конкретной.
strengths.example: knowing the history of the Kazakh Khanate or of the difficult twentieth century

strengths.en: The conclusion does not just criticise; it suggests using the same media.
strengths.kk: Қорытынды үрдісті жай сынамайды, сол медианы пайдалануды ұсынады.
strengths.ru: Вывод не просто ругает тренд, а предлагает использовать те же медиа.

title.en: A judgement with a way out

strengths.example: presenting the past through stories, films and the digital media that young people already use

note.en: Introduction: a contrast in two halves of one sentence and a thesis answering both questions.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бір сөйлемнің екі бөлігіндегі қарама-қайшылық және екі сұраққа жауап беретін тезис.
note.ru: Введение: контраст в двух частях одного предложения и тезис, который отвечает на оба вопроса.

note.en: Answer to “why”: entertainment algorithms versus the dry way history is taught.
note.kk: «Неге» сұрағына жауап: ойын-сауық алгоритмдері мен мектептегі тарихтың құрғақ берілуі.
note.ru: Ответ на «почему»: алгоритмы развлечений против сухой подачи истории в школе.

note.en: A short concession: the trend has a harmless side too.
note.kk: Қысқа мойындау: үрдістің зиянсыз жағы да бар.
note.ru: Короткая уступка: у тренда есть и безобидная сторона.

note.en: The negative judgement: understanding the present, an example from Kazakh history and the risk of distorted history online.
note.kk: «Жаман» деген баға: бүгінгіні түсіну, Қазақстан тарихы мысалы және желідегі бұрмаланған тарих қаупі.
note.ru: Оценка «плохо»: понимание настоящего, пример истории Казахстана и риск искажённой истории в сети.

note.en: Conclusion: the cause, the judgement and a solution — how to revive interest in history.
note.kk: Қорытынды: себеп, баға және шешім — тарихқа қызығушылықты қалай қайтаруға болады.
note.ru: Вывод: причина, оценка и решение — как вернуть интерес к истории.

document.title: Celebrities and national history
document.question:
Many young people today know more about international celebrities than about the history of their own country. Some see this as a natural result of modern media, while others believe it is a serious loss for society.

Why is this the case? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
